device.name: Anki Overdrive / Anki Drive Smart Cars
device.notes:
Anki Overdrive and Anki Drive are BLE-controlled smart battle cars that run on a physical track. Anki ceased operations in April 2019; Digital Dream Labs bought the assets and then itself collapsed — so the cars are doubly abandoned, a maximum rescue case. Usefully, Anki itself published drive-sdk (Apache-2.0), a C implementation of the vehicle message protocol and advertisement parsing.
CONTROL: pure BLE, no cloud, no pairing secret. Service UUID BE15BEEF-6186-407E-8381-0BD89C4D8DF4 (ANKI_STR_SERVICE_UUID); read characteristic BE15BEE0-6186-407E-8381-0BD89C4D8DF4; write characteristic BE15BEE1-6186-407E-8381-0BD89C4D8DF4. The SDK parses the BLE advertisement (local name / manufacturer data) to identify cars and covers a limited initial protocol subset (set speed, change lane, etc.) via messages written to the write characteristic and telemetry notified on the read characteristic.

openness.notes: Anki published drive-sdk (official, Apache-2.0) documenting the GATT profile, advertisement parsing and a message subset; the community extended it. Nothing here was reverse-engineered from a hostile target.

credentials.notes: No pairing secret or application-layer auth; BLE connection is open.

factory_reset.effect: No documented factory-reset procedure; the cars store no network or cloud state. Charging on the track is the only persistent state change.

methods.description: Scan for the ANKI service UUID, connect, subscribe to the read characteristic (BE15BEE0) for telemetry, and write vehicle messages to the write characteristic (BE15BEE1).

steps.action: Scan for service be15beef-... and connect to the car.
Subscribe to BE15BEE0 (read) and write vehicle messages to BE15BEE1 (write).

setup.notes: Nothing to provision: connect over BLE to the service/characteristics above; no cloud or account. Confidence high on the GATT surface (verified from the official header).

rejoin.notes: No network membership; a new BLE client connects independently.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The service and characteristic UUIDs are read from anki/drive-sdk's vehicle_gatt_profile.h.

entities.notes: Set-speed message written to the control characteristic (drive-sdk protocol.h).

characteristics.notes: Vehicle telemetry / event notifications (position, version, status).

characteristics.name: Write (control)
characteristics.notes: Vehicle control messages (set speed, change lane, SDK mode, ping). Payload formats are defined in drive-sdk's protocol.h.

services.name: Anki vehicle service
services.notes: ANKI_STR_SERVICE_UUID. Telemetry is notified on the read characteristic (BE15BEE0); control messages are written to the write characteristic (BE15BEE1). Message payloads are the Anki vehicle protocol (set speed, change lane, etc.) — see drive-sdk protocol.h.
